sql: select lo.strategy, split_part(lo.market_ticker,'-',1) ser, count(*) orders, count(*) filter (where lo.status ilike '%fill%' or lo.status ilike '%execut%') filled_like,  min(lo.created_at)::date first, max(lo.created_at) last, string_agg(distinct lo.status, ',') statuses from live_orders lo where lo.created_at > now() - interval '10 days' and lo.strategy ilike '%mmsell%'  and split_part(lo.market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXNFLTOTAL','KXITFMATCH','KXITFWMATCH','KXATPCHALLENGERMATCH','KXWTACHALLENGERMATCH') group by 1,2 order by 1,2
